name: Radioactive Decay
subject: nuclear physics

source.creator: 3D Education Engine
source.attribution: Educational model generated procedurally by 3D Education Engine, based on the standard equations of motion stated in the simulation.

educational.disclaimer: 400 unstable nuclei (green). Each one decays (grey) at a random moment; nobody can say which will go next, but half of them have gone after every half-life. The curve is what is left.

equations: after one half-life half are left, after two a quarter, after three an eighth
